name: Grixis
description: Grixis is one of the five shards of Alara, a black-aligned world of death and undead dominated by demons and necromancers.

bio.text: Tezzeret awoke on Grixis after planeswalking blindly, and he reached Nicol Bolas there.

"Tezzeret", section "The Seekers' Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citations.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

bio.text: Grixis became part of the New Alara, and after Malfegor died chaos reigned among its factions.

citations.text: "Grixis", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

status.text: Grixis is part of the reunited New Alara, last mentioned as a world of death and decay where Meren learned necromancy.

citations.text: "Grixis", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Meren", section "Vengeance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grixis separated from Alara and lost access to white and green mana.
timeline.quote: But when the subplane became separated from the others, it lost access to its white and green mana.

citation.text: "Alive and Unwell". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Necromancer barons and demon lords conquered more of the lands of the living, and the plane became known as Grixis.
timeline.quote: After the corruption of Sedris, the plane became known as Grixis.

citation.text: "Alive and Unwell". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grixis, cut off from green and white mana, becomes a hellish world ruled by undeath and tormented by demons.
timeline.quote: it naturally gave rise to a hellish world ruled by undeath and tormented by demons

citation.text: "Faction + Fiction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: An archdemon's necropolis at Unx was once a living city.
timeline.quote: The necropolis at Unx was once a living city, its streets untrodden by death.

citation.text: Archdemon of Unx (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Shungus Nod's last notes record unearthing a chamber of extinct Grixis species.
timeline.quote: On our thirty-fourth day of digging, we unearthed a chamber

citation.text: Dreg Reaver (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sedris says the future is a snake devouring life backward.
timeline.quote: The future is a snake, devouring your life backwards through time.

citation.text: Shadowfeed (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Olcot warns that the ruins of Sedraxis, once a shining capital in Vithia, are a blight.
timeline.quote: They say the ruins of Sedraxis were once a shining capital in Vithia.

citation.text: Crumbling Necropolis (Shards of Alara, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Grixis is cut off from white and green mana by the Sundering, and demons, witches and necromancers gain power while angels go extinct.
timeline.quote: its angels soon went extinct

citation.text: "Grixis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Half of the Riftclan Tol Breot is transported to Grixis during the Conflux.
timeline.quote: Half the clan was transported to Grixis during the Conflux .

citation.text: "Human", section "Jund". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grixis's humans are near extinction by the time of the Conflux.
timeline.quote: but were near extinction by the time of the Conflux

citation.text: "Human", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Conflux, Grixis captures the Bloodhall and overlays the Eternal Crags, which crumble to dust.
timeline.quote: Captured by Grixis during the Conflux

citation.text: "Jund", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Half of Riftclan Tol Breot is transported to Grixis during the Conflux.
timeline.quote: Half the clan was transported to Grixis during the Conflux

citation.text: "Jund", section "Known clans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret awakes on Grixis after planeswalking blindly through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: he awoke to find himself on Grixis

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "The Seekers' Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Nicol Bolas, who promises power in exchange for servitude.
timeline.quote: who promised him power in exchange for servitude

citation.text: "Tezzeret", section "The Seekers' Fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The column notes that Grixis was once connected to the other shards and flush with life, before becoming a world of death.
timeline.quote: Grixis is a world of death—but at one time, when Alara was young, it was still connected to the other shards, and still flush with life.

citation.text: "Shards of Alara in Italics". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Eliza waits outside the necropolis of Unx as one of few living humans left on Grixis, determined to stay alive.
timeline.quote: She was one of few vital humans left on Grixis, and she was determined to remain that way.

citation.text: "Encounter at the Necropolis". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Esper's sphinxes decide war is the only recourse after their etherium gifts are spurned, and Esper mages go hunting carmot.
timeline.quote: The sphinxes decide that war is the only recourse

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grixis's demons and undead swarm across the borders to feed on the life essence of the neighboring shards.
timeline.quote: the demons and undead horrors swarm into the adjacent borderlands like a plague, gorging on all the life essence they encounter.

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas orders his general Malfegor to assemble an army of necromancers and undead and destroy remaining human holdouts on Grixis.
timeline.quote: He bids Malfegor assemble an army of the most powerful necromancers and the most horrifying undead

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jund's goblins and landwurms spill into the neighboring shards and hellkites find new threats to their dominion.
timeline.quote: The goblin tribes of Jund began to explore the new lands

citation.work: The First Days of the Conflux
citation.text: "The First Days of the Conflux". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A parasitic strix, finding no food on Grixis's edges, turns to the skies of Bant.
timeline.quote: After finding no sustenance on the edges of Grixis, it turned to the skies of Bant.

citation.text: Parasitic Strix (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As Grixis collides with the rest of Alara, the worlds begin to hear the whispers of the forgotten dead.
timeline.quote: As Grixis collided with the rest of Alara, the worlds began to hear the hateful whispers of the forgotten dead.

citation.text: Voices from the Void (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Esper thieves find it easy to explore the ruins of Grixis.
timeline.quote: thieves from Esper found it surprisingly easy to explore the ruins of Grixis.

citation.text: Vectis Agents (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The dead of Grixis catch the scent of life and follow it into Jund.
timeline.quote: The ripe smell of life drifted into Grixis.

citation.text: Zombie Outlander (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Goblins go to sleep in Jund and wake in Grixis facing zombies.
timeline.quote: The goblins went to sleep in Jund and awoke in Grixis.

citation.text: Unstable Frontier (Conflux, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Malfegor kills the archangel Asha in Bant and is exiled to Grixis.
timeline.quote: he killed an archangel named Asha but was exiled to Grixis

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After the Mending, Nicol Bolas orders Malfegor to prepare an army against the other Shards.
timeline.quote: the elder dragon Nicol Bolas told Malfegor to prepare an army to attack the other Shards

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Conflux floods Grixis with life energies; the undead invade nearby planes.
timeline.quote: the life energies of green and white mana flooded into Grixis

citation.text: "Grixis", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grixis becomes part of the New Alara, demon cults rise, and after Malfegor dies chaos reigns among factions.
timeline.quote: After the death of the plane's de facto leader, Malfegor , chaos reigns

citation.text: "Grixis", section "Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Grixis terrain bursts through Jund lava while Jund crags pierce Grixis necropolises.
timeline.quote: The dead terrain of Grixis would burst up through Jund's red-hot pools of lava, while the volcanic crags would pierce through Grixis's necropolises.

citation.text: "Incursion Zones". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The column explains that the Conflux has so far physically overlapped only adjacent shards, so Esper's main conflicts are with Bant and Grixis.
timeline.quote: the main conflicts for Esper have been with Bant and Grixis

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Esper and Grixis crush together at their frontiers, with thousands dying.
timeline.quote: Thousands die at every frontier!

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The knight rides into Grixis, completing his circuit, and recognizes the world that spawned Zarratha.
timeline.quote: He recognized the home-world that spawned Zarratha, the lich who harvested the souls of his clanmates.

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The knight fights through Grixis and finds his dead clanmates forming Zarratha's front lines.
timeline.quote: No. Dead. Forming the front lines for the lich Zarratha.

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Using mana he never understood, the knight unleashes dragonfire, Zarratha perishes, and he cremates his friends and returns home to found a new warrior-clan.
timeline.quote: It's the story of how the lich Zarratha perished under a siege of dragonfire

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas recognizes his memory and power slipping away because of the Mending.
timeline.quote: Yet that healing event has effectively put limits on Bolas's capacity for power

citation.work: The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas
citation.text: "The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Bolas forms a multi-part plan to restore his glory and gain unmatched power, with little time left.
timeline.quote: He's got a plan to head off this brutal decay, and to not only restore his former glory, but to assume total, unmatched power in the multiverse.

citation.work: The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas
citation.text: "The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Riftclan Tol Breot is blasted from Jund into Grixis, loses half its clan, and is attacked by rot-skinned ogres.
timeline.quote: The Riftclan Tol Breot was lost in an unfamiliar land.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Breot decides to keep the sick survivors together instead of leaving them behind.
timeline.quote: But Breot made the unexpected decision to keep all the survivors together and nurse the sick.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A pale black-haired boy arrives at the camp and warns the Riftclan to flee; Breot refuses.
timeline.quote: "You must flee. Quickly."

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Thraximundar charges over the ridge with swarms of undead and cuts Breot down before he can raise his sword; the undead engulf the clan.
timeline.quote: Leading swarms of undead, Thraximundar charged down the hill and cut Breot down before the chieftain could raise his sword or utter a single word.

citation.text: "The Face of War". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Malfegor, a Grixis monster, remembers when he was the most fearsome being on young Alara and seeks only to restore his lost position.
timeline.quote: He remembers the old days, when he was the most fearsome being on a young Alara

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: A knight embraces all of Alara, Grixis as much as Bant, though his former home calls him traitor.
timeline.quote: Let my former home call me traitor.

citation.text: Knight of New Alara (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Jharic returns from Grixis changed and destroys her foes with unholy glee.
timeline.quote: Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes.

citation.text: Zealous Persecution (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sedris, the Traitor King, declares an end to wariness and prudence.
timeline.quote: Too wary to charge, too prudent to serve. Not anymore.

citation.text: Sewn-Eye Drake (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Naya elves journey through the rotting land of Grixis, and Grixis undead assault a Bant stronghold, as examples of Alara Reborn's fusion of shards.
timeline.quote: Zealous Persecution shows Grixis undead assaulting a Bant stronghold.

citation.text: "Reality Check". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 11 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Banath'thur tempts the æthermage Revin Skoros with exotic mana bonds, and Skoros becomes one of the Damned.
timeline.quote: If the demon Banath'thur hadn't tempted Skoros with promises of exotic new bonds to sources of mana

citation.text: "Gold Records". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Vithians imprison Banath'thur in vaults under their hermitage.
timeline.quote: The demon Banath'thur was imprisoned by astute Vithian humans of Grixis.

citation.text: "Gold Records". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 19 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Some Grixis humans stayed behind rather than emigrate after the Conflux.
timeline.quote: I actually do think there are some living Grixis humans who didn't emigrate after the Conflux.

citation.work: Once More Unto the Mailbox, Dear Friends
citation.text: "Once More Unto the Mailbox, Dear Friends". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Descendants of Vithia in Grixis hope to rebuild the fallen kingdom as green and white mana trickles back.
timeline.quote: these neo-Vithians might hold out hope that they could rebuild the kingdom's fallen glory

citation.work: Once More Unto the Mailbox, Dear Friends
citation.text: "Once More Unto the Mailbox, Dear Friends". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 26 May 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Grixis falls under Bolas's sway while Esper ignores his influence until too late.
timeline.quote: Grixis was firmly under the sway of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Nicol Bolas, Archenemy". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jul 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Alara breaks into five shards, so Grixis feels a strong hunger for white and green mana.
timeline.quote: When Alara broke into its five shards, the hunger for those life-oriented colors of mana, white and green, was strongly felt.

citation.work: The Art of New Phyrexia's Factions
citation.text: "The Art of New Phyrexia's Factions". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Malfegor captures Dack on Grixis hoping to steal his spark, but Dack escapes.
timeline.quote: Before Malfegor could attempt his plan, though, Dack escaped

citation.text: "Dack Fayden", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Derevi's strategy routs the Grixis hordes at the Battle of Split Peak.
timeline.quote: Her brilliant strategy routed the Grixis hordes at the Battle of Split Peak.

citation.text: "The Ten Commanders". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2013. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Meren spends years in the deadlands of Grixis, learning from necromancers and discovering how to Borrow the dead.
timeline.quote: she learned to revitalize the deceased

citation.text: "All the Cairns of Jund" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Nov 2015.

timeline.summary: Jharic returned from Grixis changed and destroyed her foes with unholy glee.
timeline.quote: Jharic returned from Grixis changed

citation.text: Zealous Persecution (Eternal Masters, 2016), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
timeline.quote: But now they have converged into one, and the rejoined plane flows with all five colors of mana once more.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolve, cultures clash and wars ensue.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Grixis undead assault other shards to maim, enslave and drain life energy.
timeline.quote: Hordes of Grixis undead mount an assault to maim, enslave, and drain the life energy from other shards.

citation.text: "Alara". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Malfegor slays the archangel Asha and is exiled to Grixis.
timeline.quote: he slew the archangel Asha

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "Before the Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Grixis Malfegor kidnaps and tortures fledgling planeswalkers; his first success is Sifa Grent.
timeline.quote: His first success was Sifa Grent .

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "On Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dack Fayden is imprisoned, escapes, and kills Malfegor's head jailer.
timeline.quote: After Dack killed Malfegor's head jailer, Malfegor tried to take matters into his own hands but Dack escaped.

citation.text: "Malfegor", section "On Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Trained in Grixis, Meren reanimates a great dragon, Skaal Kesh.
timeline.quote: reanimated a great dragon she deemed Skaal Kesh

citation.text: "Meren", section "Vengeance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rafiq rescues Levac and Salay from Grixis and fails to exorcise their zombified son.
timeline.quote: Rafiq managed to rescue Levac and Salay from Grixis

citation.text: "Rafiq", section "The Conflux". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sifa ascends as a planeswalker when the demon Malfegor tries to steal her spark.
timeline.quote: Sifa ascended when the demon Malfegor tried to steal Sifa's spark

citation.text: "Sifa Grent", section "Grixis". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Today it's known as Sedraxis, the largest necropolis on the plane

citation.text: "Alive and Unwell". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Surviving Vithian humans live on Grixis.
relations.quote: even the surviving Vithian humans are often aligned with Grixis's blue or red aspects rather than black

citation.text: "Faction + Fiction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: The necromancer barons and demon lords display Grixis's power-driven characteristics.
relations.quote: The necromancer barons and demon lords of the plane certainly display all of these characteristics, in a way.

citation.text: "Faction + Fiction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: The necropolis at Unx lies on Grixis.
relations.quote: a species almost forgotten on Grixis

citation.text: "Encounter at the Necropolis". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Oct 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Their shards have crushed together in conflict.

citation.text: "Tipping the Scales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Zarratha is from Unx in Grixis.
relations.quote: a lich lord from the necropolis of Unx, shard of Grixis

citation.text: "Circumnavigation". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Mar 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: the perfect emblem for his temporary abode, the shard of Grixis

citation.work: The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas
citation.text: "The One, The Only, Nicol Bolas". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: Malfegor is another Grixis monster who's trying to ply a strategy of business as usual.

citation.text: "Choices in the New Alara". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Apr 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: They scavenge the realms of Grixis.
relations.quote: that scavenge the death-choked realms of Grixis

citation.text: "Graduation Day". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jun 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.note: Vithians actively hunt the undead of Grixis.
relations.quote: a group of humans called the Vithians actively hunt the undead

"Grixis", section "Notable inhabitants". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: One of the Shards of Alara, a land of undead savagery.

citation.text: "The Savory Mailbag". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: Realm of disease, horror and the undead.

citation.text: "Running Wild". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A shard of Alara that split off and lost its white and green mana, now overrun by necromancers, demons and undead, where humanity may go extinct within years.

citation.text: "Alive and Unwell". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A shard of Alara cut off from green and white mana, a hellish world ruled by undeath and tormented by demons.

citation.text: "Faction + Fiction". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Sep 2008. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: The shard of undeath, necromancer barons and demons where death and decay abound.

citation.work: Shards of Alara: card flavor text
